Description

Savills are Delighted to Present this Stunning Fully Furnished One Double Bedroom Apartment in the Hallmark Development.

This fantastic apartment has a pleasant entrance hallway leading to a open-plan living/kitchen area. The living room itself is a well-designed, practical space whilst the kitchen comes fully fitted with integrated appliances. The bedroom is well-appointed and spacious with built-in wardrobes offering ample space for storage. The bathroom enjoys a modern three-piece suite.

The Hallmark development offers two communal terraces with the 12th floor roof terrace benefitting from far reaching views of the city. Hallmark also offers bike storage and concierge services. Located in close proximity to Manchester Victoria Station and with the bars and restaurants the Northern Quarter has to offer only a short distance away, this development appeals to all.

This property has cladding, as far as we know the current position with the property is: It’s been tested and there are no works required.*
